title: Technical Support Specialist T3
why_it_fits: Customer Support match. 4 skills: google sheets, zendesk, intercom, excel. Yes PH eligibility signal
position_overview:
A LITTLE BIT ABOUT Boldr
- Boldr is the first global B-Corp dedicated to delivering world-class Client experiences while creating access to dignified, meaningful work in communities worldwide.
- We are a global team, united by our desire to connect diverse people with shared values for boldr impact.
- We employ just over a thousand team members across five countries and we want to employ over 5,000 people by 2027, if not sooner.

LET'S START WITH OUR VALUES
- Meaningful connections start with AUTHENTICITY
- We do our best work by being CURIOUS
- We grow by remaining DYNAMIC
- Our success combines AMBITIOUS VISION with OPERATIONAL EXCELLENCE
- At the heart of great partnerships, we'll always find EMPATHY

WHAT IS YOUR ROLE

The Technical Support Specialist provides advanced high-level technical to developers building on an open-weight AI model platform serving as the ultimate escalation point for complex technical issues. This role owns the full range of inbound queries, from billing and account issues to API errors, and resolves them with accuracy, ownership, and a strong customer focus. You will apply working knowledge of SQL, APIs, SDKs, developer tools, and web applications to diagnose issues, use sound judgment where no defined process exists, and help build the support function as the product evolves.

WHY DO WE WANT YOU

We are currently looking for impact-driven individuals who are passionate in helping Boldr grow and achieve our Purpose. We expect our Team to become our ultimate partners to success by always giving their 110% in everything, sharing their talents and quirks, and championing our core values: Curious, Dynamic and Authentic.

WHAT WILL YOU DO
- Provide technical support to developers via live chat and email in Intercom, owning the full range of queries from billing, payments, credits, and token limits to API errors
- Debug, optimize, and troubleshoot complex API, SDK, and developer toolkit issues, system behaviors, and web-application architectures.
- Clearly communicate resolution timelines, status updates, and next steps to customers with direct leaders and client stakeholders
- Use sound judgment to resolve issues where no defined process exists, adapting as the product changes
- Build, maintain and structure technical knowledge bases and SOPs to support the client and contribute to the foundations of the support function, including workflows, documentation, and knowledge-sharing initiatives
- Identify recurring issues and documentation gaps, and recommend process or system improvements
- Collaborate with internal engineering and product teams by reproducing issues and escalating confirmed product bugs with clear, concise documentation
- Maintain high standards of client satisfaction, accuracy, and responsiveness
- Act as the highest escalation point for complex technical issues, owning every query the AI support agent does not resolve, except confirmed product bugs
- Hand over open conversations cleanly at the end of each shift
- Annual cybersecurity refreshers
- Complete assigned learning courses aligned with Team Captain criteria within the first 90 days and ongoing as part of professional development

WHAT WE'LL LIKE ABOUT YOU

YOU ARE...
- A clear, professional, and customer-focused communicator
- Friendly, confident, and approachable with clients and teammates
- Detail-oriented with strong problem-solving skills
- Able to manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced environment
- Curious about technology and driven to continuously learn
- Proactive in identifying issues and suggesting improvements
- Structured in your thinking, able to balance short-term fixes with long-term improvements
- Able to thrive in ambiguous situations, using sound judgment with limited day-to-day supervision
- You are able to adapt to schedule changes (Primary schedule follows US business hour, but schedule may change depending on operational needs)

YOU HAVE...
- At least 3 years of working experience in Technical Support is required, including supporting developers or technical users at a developer-tool, API, or AI-native company
- Practical working knowledge of SQL to look up usage, billing, and credit data when troubleshooting
- Working knowledge of REST APIs, API keys, authentication, and rate limits, with comfort reading API docs, error messages, and code samples
- Experience supporting software, data platforms, or web-based applications
- Proven experience working with ticket tracking systems like Jira, Zendesk
- Maintain an open and flexible schedule.
- Ability to manage competing priorities and meet deadlines consistently
- Strong understanding of how web applications function and how data flows between systems
- Experience working in a client-facing technical support role (preferred)
- Comfort working with tools such as Google Sheets or similar data analysis tools
- Strong written and verbal communication skills
- Experience with usage-based billing or credit systems (preferred)
- Hands-on use of large language model APIs (preferred)
- Experience contributing to process improvements, documentation, or support team foundations.
- Experience at an early-stage company or on a new support team (preferred)
- Available to work US business hours, with flexibility based on operational needs
key_responsibilities:
WHAT YOU'LL DO:
- Compose thoughtful, personalized responses to a variety of customer requests
- Triage incoming requests and spot trends in customer issues to flag for the wider team
- Interact with customers to provide and process accurate, valid, and complete information with the highest degree of empathy, courtesy, and professionalism
- Log, manage, and follow up on all customer support tickets
- Perform problem-solving tasks, provide answers to product-related questions and troubleshooting and ensure that issues are properly documented, prioritized, tracked, and resolved
- Perform ad hoc tasks when requested by the client
- Proactively monitor the client's dashboards and platforms and actively reach out to customers who need extra support with troubleshooting
- Ensure proper and timely escalation of issues to meet internal and external expectations
- Identify opportunities and recommendations for continuous process improvement
- Deliver service excellence and maximize customer service and satisfaction
- Work with the external team to stay updated on product and service knowledge

WHAT WE'LL LIKE ABOUT YOU

YOU ARE...
- Curious and authentic, just like us! #beboldr
- An analytical and critical thinker, with an eye for even the most minute of details
- Passionate about client satisfaction
- Proactive and self-motivated
- Strongly interested in learning new ideas, processes, and unique requirements. On top of that, you're willing to share your skills and talents with the team.
- Amenable to work on rotating shifts

YOU HAVE...
- At least a bachelor's degree in any field you're passionate about!
- At least 3 years of working experience in Technical Support is required
- Excellent English communication skills
- Willingness to learn about how networks and IT technology behave and operate
- Basic knowledge of cloud-based applications (Google Drive, Google Sheets, Google Docs) and MS Office applications
- Excellent verbal and written communication skills
- An ability to understand and communicate complex ideas to customers, both verbally and in written form
- Aptitude to quickly learn and navigate new technology, systems, and applications
- Ability to accept feedback gracefully and with an open mind
- Customer orientation and ability to adapt/respond to different types of characters
- Available to work US business hours, with flexibility based on operational needs.
